capabilities: Render related notes from a see-also frontmatter property in a sidebar view
Suggest notes that share tags with the active note
Exclude high-volume tags such as daily-notes tags from suggestions
Group explicit and tag-based suggestions under configurable labels
Open related notes in the same or a new tab
extras: Automatic tag suggestions scan all vault markdown file paths (not contents) entirely locally and are disabled by default; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in panel for showing hand-picked related notes declared in a note's frontmatter.
summary: Sidebar panel that lists related notes from a see-also frontmatter property, with optional tag-based automatic suggestions.
